intent.summary: References a separately defined semantic UI subtree through a stable component contract.
useWhen: A reusable or independently translated component occupies this position
avoidWhen: The referenced content has no stable identity or contract

semantics.childPolicy: resolved component root supplies children; inline children are prohibited
semantics.sizing: resolved component participates normally in parent constraints
semantics.ordering: occupies one position in its parent's semantic order

attributes.name: componentId
attributes.description: Stable identifier of the referenced component definition.

attributes.name: inputs
attributes.description: Named data and configuration inputs passed to the component.

attributes.name: identity
attributes.description: Stable instance identity when state preservation requires it.

constraints.message: A component reference must resolve to one definition.
Component references cannot form an unbounded cycle.

notes: The reference wrapper does not create an accessibility node.

mappings.strategy: Resolve declarations and bind constructor arguments to component inputs.
Select a generated or mapped target component with an explicit contract.
caveats: Code-behind behavior is outside the layout pattern.

mappings.strategy: Map through Qt Quick or Qt Widgets constructs using the same layout intent and accessibility contract.
caveats: Qt Quick and Qt Widgets differ in sizing, ownership, and event wiring.
